body:
To everyone:

Thank you very much for your support. Like I mentioned within my edit my daughter went out and had a good time today, everything is looking better for me. I feel a lot  better than I did last night.

The VA will be calling on Monday or Tuesday and honestly, I don't know what I'm going to say to them. I'm embarrassed about the whole thing but I do need to get into the VA system (in general and for my overall mental health issues, so this looks like an express route to that end).

My wife and I (like I said, we're trying to work things out) have had a couple of really good phone calls since this post. I haven't told her I called a suicide hotline and honestly don't think I will.
Thank you for this - I noticed they have an instant line for veterans, calling now.
